title: Permissions
description: Choose what the permissions go on: a role, a group of roles, one person or a group of people, then tick what they may do and how far.
kindHint: A group of roles is given to a person who then gets all its roles and permissions; a group of people is a set of chosen people who get the same permissions.

matrixHint.role: Apply to everyone who holds this role.
matrixHint.role-group: Apply to everyone the group is given to and to everyone who holds one of its roles, on top of the permissions of its roles.
matrixHint.user: Belong to this person alone, on top of what their roles and groups give.
matrixHint.user-group: Apply to every member of the group.

roleGroups.title: Groups of roles
roleGroups.description: Bundle roles that go together under one name; giving the group to a person gives them every role in it.
roleGroups.deleteBody: The group "{{name}}" is deleted and the people it was given to lose the permissions of its roles that came through it.
roleGroups.addRole: Add a role to the group
roleGroups.addRoleHint: Choose from the existing roles; search by name.
roleGroups.noRolesYet: No roles in this group yet.
roleGroups.rolesHint: Everyone who holds one of these roles gets the permissions placed on the group, with the same scope and list of fields.
roleGroups.rolesSaved: The roles of the group were saved.

userGroups.title: Groups of people
userGroups.description: Choose specific people who get the same permissions; the permissions of the group are set on the permissions page.
userGroups.searchPerson: Search for a person to add
userGroups.searchHint: Type the first letter of the name or e-mail to see matching people.
userGroups.deleteBody: The group “{{name}}” is deleted and its members lose the permissions that came through it.

deleteGroupBody.role-group: The group “{{name}}” is deleted and the people it was given to lose the permissions that came through it.
deleteGroupBody.user-group: The group “{{name}}” is deleted and its members lose the permissions that came through it.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.body: Every page and button has a permission key. This page shows what each role, group and person holds, and at which scope (all, the unit, or only their own). Beside «Edit employees» a button chooses which fields its holder may change and which not.

can.usergroup: Change a group of people’s permissions

noTargets.role-group: No groups of roles yet. Create the first with the «New group of roles» button below.
noTargets.user-group: No groups of people yet. Create the first with the button below.

targetHint.user: Open the list for the first names, or type a letter of the name or e-mail to narrow it.
